title: Mandela effect: remembered death of Nelson Mandela in prison

plain: The Mandela effect is the name for a memory that a large group of people share. It comes from the many people who remember Nelson Mandela, the South African freedom leader, dying in prison in the 1980s. Michels explains the term himself in an episode about the idea that our universe is a kind of hologram.
